_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::heat#1 — VELOCITYFIELD is optional because 'zero' is already its default, and the omission is completely silent. On a 3-D HEX8 heat-conduction deck the explicit and the omitted arms both exit 0 with the same result test CORRECT at 1e-12, and the substring 'velocit' appears zero times anywhere in the omitted arm's log (OMITTED_MENTIONS_VELOCITY=0). Two further arms show the silence is a measurement and not an absence of checking: VELOCITYFIELD 'Navier_Stokes' aborts from src/scatra/4C_scatra_dyn.cpp with 'If you want non-matching fluid and scatra meshes, you need to use FIELDCOUPLING volmortar!', and an illegal value makes 4C print the legal set verbatim — "Candidate deprecated_selection 'VELOCITYFIELD' has wrong value, possible values: Navier_Stokes|function|zero". Both diagnostics an earlier version of this entry quoted for the omission are absent (CLAIMED_VELOCITY_FIELD_NOT_FOUND=0, CLAIMED_VELNP_UNINITIALIZED=0). Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C 2026.2.0-dev (git 89519cf) at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C.
expect_in_output: If you want non-matching fluid and scatra meshes, you need to use FIELDCOUPLING volmortar!
Candidate deprecated_selection 'VELOCITYFIELD' has wrong value, possible values: Navier_Stokes|function|zero

_mutation.note: remove the pathology: put VELOCITYFIELD back into the omitted arm. There is then no omission under test, OMITTED_DECK_HAS_VELOCITYFIELD becomes 1 and the fixture must go red.

remove the control: give the illegal-value arm a legal value. 4C has nothing to object to, the printed enum list disappears and the fixture must go red — that list is the only evidence of what the legal spellings are.
remove the second control: run the Navier_Stokes arm with the default instead. Its mesh-coupling abort disappears and the fixture must go red.
